description: Na₄ScTa(SiO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.86 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.45 Å) and three longer (2.64 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.03 Å) and three longer (2.16 Å) Sc-O bond lengths. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.97 Å) and three longer (2.05 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.69 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Sc, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₃ScSi trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ta, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one Si atom.
